Thanks for the patience — please find the updated materials requested:

- Attached: redwood_subprocessors_20270521.csv (updated) — now includes: cloud provider, primary region, data categories processed (plaintext, hashed, metadata), and purpose (compute, storage, monitoring).
- Attached: SOC2_summary_2026.pdf — summary of our SOC 2 Type II, with steps to request the full report under NDA.
- Questionnaire: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1a2B3cAcmeSecurityQuestionnaire — this is a short vendor security intake that maps to our SOC 2 controls; please complete and we’ll prioritize your items.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- Cloud providers: Primary: AWS (us-west-2) for production; S3 replication to eu-west-1 for EU-bound accounts only (customer-configurable). No plaintext replication to other third regions without explicit config.
- Analytics/monitoring: We use a separate telemetry pipeline (hashed identifiers only) for service health. No customer PII is sent to analytics vendors.
- PII redaction: We support configurable redaction rules at ingestion and a customer-visible deletion API. Default retention for pilot logs is 30 days; configurable in contract.

If you prefer a quick call to walk Legal through the SOC 2 and the subprocessors, happy to schedule. Next step from our side: once the questionnaire is completed we’ll return a detailed mapping and any supporting evidence.
